plantedBugs.description: setInterval callback fires even if component unmounts — fetch/setData on unmounted component causes memory leak and React warning. Missing cleanup function.
Dependency array only includes url — if interval changes, the old interval keeps running and a new one starts. Should include interval and clear old interval.
No error handling for fetch failures — repeated 500s will spam the console and never surface to UI.
No AbortController for fetch — if component unmounts during fetch, the response may still call setData after unmount.
